notation.X_h: bitwise XOR of current column heights; named X_h here to avoid collision with the existing exact single-residual feasibility operator
notation.E1: exact single-residual support-lattice ownership-feasibility operator (called X in earlier E1 experiment artifacts)

exact_algebra.statement: For every integer support vector, p = X_h & 1. Stone-count parity is therefore not an independent coordinate once X_h is retained.
Current mover parity equals p, but final-board mover simplifies to (W*H-1) mod 2 and is independent of X_h and current p.
After a move in column c from height h_c, X_h' = X_h XOR h_c XOR (h_c+1) and p'=p XOR 1. X_h,p alone are not action-closed because h_c is additionally required.
When exactly one column is nonfull, forced owner of row r simplifies to ((W-1)*H+r) mod 2. The current-rank parity p cancels; X_h is unnecessary.
exact_algebra.finite_checks: zero mismatches across all five complete XOR/decomposition cases

bounded_falsifiers.statement: X_h, p, and (X_h,p) each fail Q-F, Q-A and Q-V on every one of the five complete bounded cases (4x4-k4 exploratory plus 4x4-k3, 3x3-k3, 3x4-k3, 4x3-k3 holdouts).

All tested support-only alternatives—rank/modular rank, sorted support multiset, elementary symmetric support invariants, power sums, transformed XORs, height-parity mask, open-column mask and combinations—fail to give a cross-case Q-F/Q-A/Q-V representation.
Residuals combined with X_h or nearby compressed support descriptors do not yield a cross-case exact representation; isolated Q-V successes on small geometries do not transfer.

The 836 previously observed transition-congruence failures of the older direct normal form all occur at identical full support before and after the common action. Parent and child X_h,p are therefore identical across each ambiguity fiber. No support-only coordinate can resolve those 836 representation splits.

relation_to_q_sigma.statement: X_h and p are invariant under every column permutation, so they are constant on each q_Sigma orbit and cannot choose a canonical representative inside the orbit.
Adding X_h,p to RFG or q_SigmaRFG adds zero classes/information in every tested case; retained support already determines them.

Column-permutation equivariance of compiled q_o is not explained by X_h. The exact equivariance law transports the entire support+owned-residual hypergraph and action labels; X_h is merely an invariant of that action.

safe_forgetting.statement: M/remaining-capacity deletion is determined by exact rank and residual ownership/size, not by X_h,p; X_h,p has bounded counterexamples.

R/support-release deletion is not determined by X_h,p or even X_h+rank across the full holdout set. Exact residual identity plus the support-height multiset happens to classify the tested decisions, but no general theorem is promoted from that finite pattern.
F/frontier blocking is not determined by any support-only descriptor tested, including the complete support vector; mover residual structure is independently load-bearing.

G/final-mover cap deletion and H/sole-column ownership deletion require open-column/cap incidence structure. X_h,p alone do not determine either rule. Apparent X_h+rank prediction on some geometries fails on fresh 3x3/4x3 controls.

derivational_compression.statement: On complete 4x4-k4, H is idempotent, commutes with R/F/G, is Q-F/Q-A/Q-V safe in the tested compositions, and RFGH reduces the direct representation to 29,986 classes and the S4 transporter orbit to 9,286 classes.
R, G and H each delete only residuals that E1 also deletes in all five complete tested cases.
E1 and RGH are not generally the same normalized representation or even the same partition; the strongest literal decomposition E1=RGH is falsified.

After frontier reduction, F(E1(q)) and RFGH(q) induce exactly the same partition of physical states in all five complete tested cases, with zero partition mismatches, even where their residual keys differ.
derivational_compression.interpretation: RFGH is a lossless recoding of the F∘E1 quotient in the tested domains; this is the strongest current derivational compression among the safe-forgetting rules.

current_interpretation: The XOR+parity hypothesis is retained only as a cheap algebraic checksum / turn-parity lens, not as a rank-sufficient state coordinate.
The stronger structural compression signal lies in support-lattice ownership feasibility plus frontier interaction, not in Nim-style height XOR.
F carries information independent of support geometry because it depends on the mover residual family.
The old 836 recursive ambiguities are residual-representation ambiguities and cannot be repaired by any support-only invariant.
No standard-7x6 theorem or minimality claim follows from these bounded controls.
